About Midlands Roof Repairs

Family‑run roofing specialists, based in South Normanton and covering all of Derbyshire & Nottinghamshire.

From the fascia up we've got you covered. Whether it's a single slipped tile, a full re‑roof, or a complete fascia and gutter renewal, Midlands Roof Repairs take on every job with the same impeccable craftsmanship.

Tom, Sam and the team are highly recommended by homeowners right across the region. Reviewers consistently call out our punctuality, professionalism and the way we leave the job site spotless — because the work isn't finished until everything around your home looks as good as the roof itself.

We're available around the clock for emergencies — a storm‑damaged roof or a sudden leak doesn't wait, and neither do we. Call any time for a free, no‑obligation quote. Quotes beaten.

Our Roofing Services

Full‑service roofing from minor repairs to complete re‑roofs. Every job fully insured, fully guaranteed.

🏠

Full Re‑Roofs

Complete strip‑and‑replace with new tiles or slate, fresh membrane, battens and flashings. Built to last for decades.

🔧

Roof Repairs

Slipped, broken or missing tiles repaired fast. Small leaks caught early before they become expensive interior damage.

🏗️

Fascia & Gutter Renewal

New uPVC fascias, soffits, bargeboards and seamless guttering — tidy finishes that protect your roof edges for years.

🧱

Pointing & Lead Work

Ridge and hip re‑pointing, chimney pointing, and fresh lead flashings around valleys, stacks and abutments.

💧

Leak Investigation

Tracking down persistent leaks to the true source — and fixing the cause, not just the symptom.

⚡

24/7 Emergency Call‑outs

Storm damage, sudden leaks, missing tiles after bad weather — call any time and we'll be there to make it safe.
